title: fix(console): a failed AI chat create gives back every message sent while it waited
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQHTAftkGRizntoyLHB9wzr)_

Fixes #33562

Refs #33567

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#2` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5mV4rtksbPPvwm9w8L` · claim 6889053115

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AI 对话新建会话时,用户在会话创建(`POST /conversations`)等待期间连发两条消息,若创建失败,输入框现在拿回两条(先第一条、后第二条,与合并发送时的顺序一致),再发一次即把合并后的文字发出且只发一次;之前只拿回第二条,第一条丢失。为此 `ChatbotEnhanced`(`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`)新增一个可选属性 `unsentText`,由宿主告诉它"未发出的是哪段文字";不传时行为不变。另一张卡 #33567(打开会话链接后、会话还没加载完就发消息会丢)实测不复现:在页面里发出的消息会被暂存并在会话打开后发出一次;当初测试里看到的"丢失"是测试在一个已被替换掉的旧输入框里打字。本 PR 只为它加一条钉子测试。
- 为什么改:#33562 由 #33561 的开发者实测:恢复逻辑只认输入框自己最后提交的文字,而宿主已把两条合并成一条暂存。
- 风险与回滚:只改前端(plugin-chatbot 一个可选属性 + app-shell 一行传参),不改服务端、spec、会话创建延迟或 #33561 的首条消息即时显示。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx(`ChatPane` 给 `ChatbotEnhanced` 的 `unsentText`)、ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx(未发送恢复的 effect 读 `unsentText`)、ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.firstMessageDrawnAtOnce-33420.test.tsx(新增两组钉子)。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm dev,打开 `/ai/build`,在开发者工具里把 `POST /conversations` 设为失败并节流,连发「第一条」「第二条」:创建失败后输入框是「第一条」空行「第二条」,并有未发送提示;放开后再按发送,只发出一条合并消息。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(本 PR 是 Clause-② 放宽,席位先补契约复审记录)。

## What changes

**#33562.** On a new conversation the first send creates the conversation, and `useDeferredFirstSend` holds the message until `POST /conversations` answers; a second send during that wait joins the held one (`first\n\nsecond`, since #32984). When the create failed (#33420's rollback), `ChatbotEnhanced`'s not-sent restore put back the text the composer itself last submitted, so the box got only the second part, and the held message (the only copy of the first part) was dropped so a retry would not send it twice. Measured on `origin/main` d95ddebc through the rendered page: box `"second part"` (see Tests, red first).

- `ChatbotEnhanced` gains one optional prop, `unsentText?: string`: the text a not-sent `error` gives back to the composer when the host, not the composer, holds what was not sent. The restore reads `unsentText ?? lastSubmittedRef.current`, once per not-sent error and only into an empty box, as before. One rule differs: on its own the composer restores only text the user typed (a chip or card send clears `lastSubmittedRef`, objectui#7253), while a host-named `unsentText` is restored however it was sent, a held suggestion chip included (see Acceptance notes). A host that passes nothing keeps today's restore. This is the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`.
- `ChatPane` passes `unsentText={conversationCreateError ? heldFirstMessage?.content : undefined}`. `heldFirstMessage` is the joined held message #33420 already keeps in state for drawing; in the render the create error arrives in it is still set (`useDeferredFirstSend` drops it in a passive effect of the parent, which runs after the composer's restore effect), so the composer gets the whole text. A handoff seed is never reported as held, so it still restores nothing of its own. All three hosts (the `/ai` page, the console dock, the Studio copilot) render `ChatPane`, so none needs a change.
- Changeset `.changeset/33562-ai-chat-failed-create-joined-restore.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` patch (a widening ships `patch`, AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3; app-shell is private and console's `dist` ships it).

**#33567 (measured first, does not reproduce).** On a deep link to an existing conversation (`/ai/build/conv-7`) with its `GET /conversations/conv-7` held open, a message submitted through the composer is held by `useDeferredFirstSend` (the pane is `…:pending`, so `apiMode && !conversationId`), drawn at once, and `ensureConversation` records the request without creating anything (`pendingKeyRef` is unset while the resolve runs); when the GET answers, the resolve drops that request (`finally`: a run that found a thread), the pane remounts on `conv-7` and the replay sends the message once. The #33561 observation came from the harness: `findByRole('textbox')` resolved on the `…:pending` pane's textarea, and by the time the test typed and submitted, the GET (answered at once there) had remounted the pane, so the test typed into a detached textarea (`isConnected === false` before the change event) whose form React no longer listens to. No line drops a send. This PR adds the pin only.

## Tests

- `AiChatPage.firstMessageDrawnAtOnce-33420.test.tsx` (the #33420 harness: the REAL `AiChatPage` / `ChatDockConversation`, `ChatPane`, `useChatConversation`, `useObjectChat` transport and `ChatbotEnhanced`, driven through the composer):
  - #33562, on the full-page chat and on the console dock: two sends during one held create, the create answers 503 → the box holds `first part\n\nsecond part` (first part first), no bubble is left, the send-error notice shows, nothing was sent; submitting what the box holds retries the create and the chat request carries the joined text exactly once, and the notice goes. CONTROL: the existing single-send rollback (`a failed create takes the bubble away and puts the text back in the composer`, both hosts) stays green.
  - #33567: GET of `conv-7` held, a send → drawn once, not sent, no create; the GET answers → sent once into `conv-7`, no create, drawn once, box empty. CONTROL: the existing `CONTROL: a send in an existing conversation draws and sends as before` (a send after the GET answers).
- `ChatbotEnhanced.sendError.test.tsx`: a host-named `unsentText` is what a not-sent error restores (the composer last submitted only `second part`). The existing restore tests (429, generic 5xx) are the CONTROL with no `unsentText`.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.sendError.test.tsx` (patch round 1, 07caf19a): a suggestion chip sent and then refused comes back when the host names it as `unsentText`; CONTROL in the same test: with no `unsentText` a chip restores nothing (objectui#7253 unchanged).
- Red first, sources restored to base d95ddebc with the head tests: 3 failed / 15 passed, each `expected 'second part' to be 'first part\n\nsecond part'` (the unit pin and both host pins); the #33567 pin is green on base, as the reading above says it should be.
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on head d32d4df0 (ui vitest aliases `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` to `src`, so no rebuild), each restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - `ChatPane` passes `unsentText={undefined}`: 2 failed / 16 passed (both host pins; the unit pin and the single-send CONTROL stay green);
  - the composer ignores `unsentText` (`lastSubmittedRef.current || unsentText`): 3 failed / 15 passed (the unit pin and both host pins);
  - a send in a pane with no id is not held (the stash condition `apiMode && !conversationId` ANDed with an always-false term): 9 failed / 9 passed, the #33567 pin among the red; the existing-conversation CONTROL stays green.

## Acceptance notes

- **A typed but unsent draft is lost on the pane's id remount (measured, not changed here).** `ChatPane` is keyed on `${chatApi}:${conversationId ?? 'pending'}`, and the composer's text lives in the pane. A rendered probe on `origin/main` d95ddebc: on `/ai/build/conv-7` with the GET held, text typed (not sent) into the composer is gone when the GET answers (new box `""`); on `/ai/build`, after a first send, a second message typed but not sent is gone when the create answers (new box `""`, only the first part sent). A submitted message is never lost on either path. Reported for the seat to file; it needs the draft to outlive the remount, outside this card's ruling.
- **The latency of `POST /conversations` and #33561's first-message drawing are unchanged** (the order's ⛔).
- `unsentText` is read only on a not-sent `error`; a streamed-response error and a clean submit are unchanged.
- **A held suggestion chip now comes back on a failed create (accepted by the seat, patch round 1).** An empty-state chip clicked as the first send of a new conversation is held like a typed first message. If that create fails, `ChatPane` names the held text as `unsentText`, so the chip's text comes back into the composer; before this PR nothing came back, because a chip send clears `lastSubmittedRef`. It returns the message that was not sent, not a stale delivered prompt, which is the harm objectui#7253 guards against. The restore comment and the prop doc say so, and a unit pin holds it.
- **A held message on a deep link whose GET fails hangs (measured on head d32d4df0, seat to file, not changed here).** On `/ai/build/conv-7`, a message sent while `GET /conversations/conv-7` is held, then the GET answering 503 or failing as a network error: after 3 s the bubble and thinking dots are still drawn, nothing is sent, no create is made, no notice shows and the box is empty; a second send joins the held one and hangs the same way (still nothing sent, no create, no notice). Mechanism: the resolve's catch in `useChatConversation.ts` (L1221 onward) clears the id without settling the surface (`pendingKeyRef` stays unset, so no create is ever allowed) and its `finally` (L1231) drops the recorded request, and no error reaches the host. This PR's diff does not touch that path.
